description: This file defines the implementation of NetworkQualityEstimatorParams class, including functions to retrieve network quality parameters, thresholds, and configuration settings for network quality estimation in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: NetworkQualityEstimatorParams
classes.description: Class encapsulating network quality estimation parameters, including thresholds, default observations, and configuration options.

methods.name: GetValueForVariationParam
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value as int64 from a map, or returns default if not found.

methods.name: GetDoubleValueForVariationParamWithDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value as double from a map, or returns default if not found.

methods.name: GetStringValueForVariationParamWithDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from a map, or returns default if not found.

methods.name: GetWeightMultiplierPerSecond
methods.description: Calculates the weight multiplier per second based on 'HalfLifeSeconds' parameter.

methods.name: GetPersistentCacheReadingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if persistent cache reading is enabled based on parameters.

methods.name: GetMinSocketWatcherNotificationInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum socket watcher notification interval from parameters.

methods.name: GetNameForConnectionTypeInternal
methods.description: Returns string name for a given network connection type.

methods.name: ObtainDefaultObservations
methods.description: Sets default network quality observations for various connection types, possibly overridden by parameters.

methods.name: ObtainTypicalNetworkQualities
methods.description: Sets typical network qualities for different effective connection types, possibly overridden by parameters.

methods.name: ObtainConnectionThresholds
methods.description: Sets network quality thresholds for different connection types, possibly overridden by parameters.

methods.name: GetForcedEffectiveConnectionTypeString
methods.description: Retrieves the forced effective connection type string from parameters.

methods.name: GetForcedEffectiveConnectionTypeOnCellularOnly
methods.description: Checks if forced effective connection type applies only on cellular connections.

methods.name: GetInitForcedEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Determines initial forced effective connection type based on parameters.
